title: Privacy Policy
intro: This page explains what the SiteSynergy website stores in your browser and how we use information you send us to get in touch.

sections.title: Information you provide
paragraphs: If you open your email app from the contact page and send a message, we receive your name, email address, and message to respond to your request. The website form itself does not submit or store the message on a server.

sections.title: Browser storage and cookies
paragraphs: Your selected language is stored in browser localStorage under i18nextLng. Your response to the storage notice is kept in the necessary sitesynergy-cookie-choice cookie for one year so the notice does not repeat on every visit. The current website does not set advertising or analytics cookies.
You can remove these values in your browser settings. After removal, the site returns to Persian by default and displays the storage notice again.

sections.title: Use and retention of messages
paragraphs: We use the emails you send to answer questions and follow up on your request or proposed collaboration. Retention depends on the correspondence and practical requirements. Contact us to request deletion of your correspondence.

sections.title: Sharing and external links
paragraphs: We do not sell your messages for advertising. Your email app is governed by its provider’s privacy policy. External websites linked from this site have their own policies.

sections.title: Requests and contact
paragraphs: To ask about your data or request access to, correction of, or deletion of information you sent us, email hello@sitesynergy.com. We may verify your identity to protect the information.
